claims.claim: The European Commission selected 46 new Strategic Projects across 16 member states from 102 applications.
claims.episode_span: selected 46 new Strategic Projects in 16 member states, chosen from 102 applications
claims.source_title: Commission selects 46 new Strategic Projects to bolster the EU’s supply of critical raw materials
claims.supporting_quote: The European Commission today announced that it has selected 46 new Strategic Projects across 16 Member States.

claims.claim: The Critical Raw Materials Act sets 2030 benchmarks of at least 10 percent extraction, 40 percent processing and 25 percent recycling.
claims.episode_span: EU capacity meet at least 10 percent of annual consumption for extraction, 40 percent for processing and 25 percent for recycling
claims.source_title: Commission selects 46 new Strategic Projects to bolster the EU’s supply of critical raw materials
claims.supporting_quote: by 2030 EU capacity meets at least 10% of the EU’s annual consumption for extraction, 40% for processing, and 25% for recycling of strategic raw materials

claims.claim: The 46 projects comprise eight extraction, 11 processing, 19 recycling and eight integrated projects, covering 15 of 17 strategic raw materials.
claims.episode_span: Eight projects are extraction, 11 processing and 19 recycling, plus eight integrated projects
claims.source_title: Commission selects 46 new Strategic Projects to bolster the EU’s supply of critical raw materials
claims.supporting_quote: The projects cover different stages of the raw materials value chain: eight are on extraction, 11 on processing, and 19 are recycling projects. In addition, there are eight integrated projects

claims.claim: The battery-related projects include seven on lithium, 12 on nickel, 10 on cobalt, five on manganese and four on graphite; defence-related counts are two magnesium and three tungsten; four are rare earths.
claims.episode_span: seven lithium, 12 nickel, 10 cobalt, five manganese and four graphite; two magnesium and three tungsten
claims.source_title: Commission selects 46 new Strategic Projects to bolster the EU’s supply of critical raw materials
claims.supporting_quote: They include seven projects on lithium, 12 on nickel, 10 on cobalt, five on manganese, and four on graphite

claims.claim: Romania secured two of the new EU strategic raw materials projects.
claims.episode_span: two of the new projects are in Romania
claims.source_title: Romania secures two new EU strategic raw materials projects
claims.supporting_quote: Romania secures two new EU strategic raw materials projects

claims.claim: Czech municipal elections on October 9-10 had 48 percent turnout and did not fundamentally reshape the landscape less than a year after Andrej Babis took office.
claims.episode_span: on a turnout of 48 percent
claims.source_title: Czech Local Elections Deliver Warning to Babis’s Governing Coalition
claims.supporting_quote: With all the votes counted by Sunday midday and on a relatively strong 48 per cent turnout, Czechia’s municipal elections of October 9-10 did not bring any major upheavals

claims.claim: Local associations and independents secured over 50,000 of 62,000 seats, and 22 of 27 Senate mandates need a second round on October 16-17.
claims.episode_span: more than 50,000 seats out of 62,000, while 22 of 27 Senate mandates
claims.source_title: Czech Local Elections Deliver Warning to Babis’s Governing Coalition
claims.supporting_quote: local associations and independent candidates, who secured over 50,000 seats this year out of 62,000

claims.claim: Babis said nearly 1,500 council seats confirmed ANO as the strongest force except in the Senate; ANO was first in six of 13 regional capitals versus eight in 2022.
claims.episode_span: close to 1,500 council seats showed ANO is the strongest political force at all levels except the Senate
claims.source_title: Czech Local Elections Deliver Warning to Babis’s Governing Coalition
claims.supporting_quote: With close to 1,500 council seats, Prime Minister Babis said the municipal elections confirmed that his ANO party “is the strongest political force at all levels”, except for the Senate.

claims.claim: Analysts said ANO underperformed on seats and the popular vote, with its worst Prague result and a setback in Usti nad Labem.
claims.episode_span: ANO down on both seats and the popular vote from four years ago, with its worst-ever Prague result
claims.source_title: Czech Local Elections Deliver Warning to Babis’s Governing Coalition
claims.supporting_quote: ANO underperformed compared to four years ago in terms of both municipal seats and the popular vote. It also recorded its worst-ever result in Prague and suffered a surprising setback in the northern city of Usti nad Labem

claims.claim: Motorists for Themselves broke through only in Ostrava and did poorly in Prague and Brno; SPD won fewer than 170 municipal seats.
claims.episode_span: broke through only in Ostrava and did poorly in Prague and Brno
claims.source_title: Czech Local Elections Deliver Warning to Babis’s Governing Coalition
claims.supporting_quote: managed to break through only in Ostrava while suffering poor results in the country’s two largest cities of Prague and Brno.

claims.claim: Arla will close Falbygdens Ost in Falköping, affecting about 60 jobs, citing profitability problems and falling demand.
claims.episode_span: close the Falbygdens Ost import and packaging site in Falköping, Sweden, affecting about 60 jobs
claims.source_title: Arla to close packaging plant in Sweden
claims.supporting_quote: Arla Foods has announced plans to close its Falbygdens Ost import and packaging facility in Falköping, Sweden, a decision that will impact around 60 jobs.

claims.claim: Falbygdens dessert cheeses will be phased out, some items moving to Castello, with aged Swedish cheese continuing as Kvibille; Osthuset keeps about ten roles.
claims.episode_span: Dessert cheeses sold as Falbygdens will be phased out, some popular lines moving to Castello
claims.source_title: Arla to close packaging plant in Sweden
claims.supporting_quote: dessert cheeses sold under the Falbygdens brand will also be phased out. Some of the most popular items in the range will be moved to Arla’s Castello brand, while aged Swedish cheese lines will continue under the Kvibille label.

claims.claim: Since 2023 Arla’s board has approved more than 5 billion Swedish kronor of investment in Sweden, including a 28.3 million euro expansion in Falkenberg.
claims.episode_span: more than 5 billion Swedish kronor, about 446 million dollars, of investment in Sweden
claims.source_title: Arla to close packaging plant in Sweden
claims.supporting_quote: Since 2023, the cooperative’s board has approved investments of more than Skr5bn ($446mm) in Sweden, including at sites in Götene, Linköping and Falkenberg.

claims.claim: Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed an energy ceasefire; Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that was news to him; oil prices fell and Moscow was silent.
claims.episode_span: oil prices fell after Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine had agreed an energy ceasefire
claims.source_title: Europe Today: Trump claims Ukraine-Russia energy ceasefire as Baltics stay on alert
claims.supporting_quote: Donald Trump says Russia and Ukraine have agreed an energy ceasefire. Volodymyr Zelenskyy says it was news to him.

claims.claim: Kosovo’s parliament voted to significantly curtail the powers and jurisdiction of the Kosovo Specialist Chambers, angering the EU and putting the court’s future in doubt.
claims.episode_span: voted to sharply limit the powers and jurisdiction of the Kosovo Specialist Chambers
claims.source_title: Kosovo ‘Clarifies’ Hague War Crimes Court’s Jurisdiction, But to What End?
claims.supporting_quote: In voting to significantly curtail the powers and jurisdiction of the Kosovo Specialist Chambers, parliament in Pristina has angered the EU and thrown the future of the court into doubt.

claims.claim: Telia is cutting around 900 jobs in Sweden amid restructuring.
claims.episode_span: Sweden’s Telia is cutting around 900 jobs in a corporate restructuring
claims.source_title: Sweden's Telia to Cut 900 Jobs Amid Corporate Restructuring
claims.supporting_quote: Sweden's Telia to Cut 900 Jobs Amid Corporate Restructuring

claims.claim: At least 96 percent of assessed 2026 rule-of-law recommendations were not implemented, 54 percent showed no or limited progress, and 96 percent were carried over.
claims.episode_span: at least 96 percent of rule-of-law recommendations the Commission assessed this year were not implemented
claims.source_title: The EU rule of law report: a tool that records rather than prevents?
claims.supporting_quote: In 2026, at least 96% of the recommendations assessed by the Commission had not been implemented, while more than half of the recommendations (54%) showed no or only limited progress.

claims.claim: The EU’s goods trade deficit with China was 359.3 billion euros last year, more than double 2019, and Brussels cited a daily deficit of 1.1 billion euros.
claims.episode_span: Europe’s goods deficit with China reached 359.3 billion euros last year
claims.source_title: Can China and the EU avert a trade war?
claims.supporting_quote: Last year, the EU’s trade deficit against China widened to 359.3 billion euros (US$396.2 billion), more than double that in 2019.

claims.claim: Talks ended on October 9 with a 16-point consensus, and China agreed to curb hybrid vehicle exports, with further talks set for January and March.
claims.episode_span: a 16-point consensus covering trade and investment, export controls and intellectual property
claims.source_title: Can China and the EU avert a trade war?
claims.supporting_quote: Talks between China and the EU ended late Friday, 9 October, with a 16-point consensus spanning trade and investment, export controls and intellectual property rights.

claims.claim: Emmanuel Moulin called for large French budget cuts, while Jean-Luc Mélenchon proposed a swap covering about 600 billion euros, or 18 percent of aggregate public debt, in bonds the central bank holds to maturity.
claims.episode_span: proposed dealing with about 600 billion euros — 673 billion dollars, or 18 percent of France’s aggregate public debt
claims.source_title: Mélenchon Is Right About France’s Debt
claims.supporting_quote: Jean-Luc Mélenchon, leader of La France Insoumise and a presidential contender, has put forward a proposal involving around €600 billion ($673 billion), or 18% of France’s aggregate public debt.

claims.claim: Nordic Mining’s third-quarter rutile output jumped 74 percent and garnet production beat plan.
claims.episode_span: third-quarter rutile output jumped 74 percent, and garnet production beat plan
claims.source_title: Nordic Mining’s Q3 rutile output jumps 74%, garnet production beats plan
claims.supporting_quote: Nordic Mining’s Q3 rutile output jumps 74%, garnet production beats plan
